The new facility represents the latest step in Walmart’s transformation of its supply chain, bringing associates together with advanced automation, technology and machine learning to move products faster and more efficiently. The technology enables Walmart to materially improve storage capacity and increase the number of customer orders the facility can fulfill each day compared with a traditional fulfillment center.

1. 01 Walmart opened a 900,000-sq-ft automated fulfillment center in Stockton, Calif., with about 1,000 new associates.
2. 02 Automated storage and retrieval compresses a 12-step fulfillment process to five steps.
3. 03 Walmart says next-gen facilities will bring 1-2 day shipping to 95 percent of the U.S. population.
4. 04 The retailer employs 102,900 associates in California across more than 300 stores, clubs and supply-chain facilities.
5. 05 A $1.3 billion next-gen facility in Carnesville, Ga., announced in September, is Walmart's first in the Southeast.

# Davinci Micro Fulfillment expands network, opens new eCommerce support facility in Pennsylvania

 AJOT Newsroom | Oct 07 2026 at 01:08 PM | Logistics 

Davinci Micro Fulfillment, which operates a distributed network of “micro site” fulfillment centers providing end to end order, inventory and shipping management for eCommerce sellers, has opened its sixth U.S. facility in Pennsylvania’s Jenkins Township.

Located in Luzerne County, at 141 Commonwealth Drive in CenterPoint Commerce & Trade Park South, the leased facility has 36,231 square feet of space and is purpose designed with equipment, resources and technology to support fulfillment of consumer brands marketed through eCommerce channels including Amazon, Walmart, TikTok and direct-to-consumer platforms.

Founded in 2020, Davinci forward-positions client inventory in smaller fulfillment centers close to consumers to accelerate delivery and reduce shipping costs.
